name: DonationPledgeBuilder
tagline: Donation Pledge Builder is a giving form for your church or charity website (Power Pages), your staff app (model-driven) or a canvas app.
description: Donation Pledge Builder is a giving form for your church or charity website (Power Pages), your staff app (model-driven) or a canvas app. A giver chooses how much, how often and for how long, picks the first gift date, and splits the gift across funds. While they choose, a Your pledge panel shows the total, every gift date, how much each fund receives, the tax-deductible part with an estimated deduction, and how the pledge moves a campaign towards its goal.
features: The giver picks an amount (preset chips or own amount)
How often (one-time, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, annually) and for how long
Splits the gift across funds by percentage
It shows the full gift schedule
The tax-deductible part with an estimated deduction
The effect on a campaign goal
